title: Home Purchase Financing Payoff Desk Figures — Statement Fee, Issue Time, Good-Through Period and Lien Release
content:
These are the per-program payoff figures for Home Purchase Financing loans, as the payoff desk quotes them.

| Program | Payoff statement fee (USD) | Statement issued within (business days of the request) | Payoff figure good through (calendar days after the statement date) | Prepayment penalty | Lien released within (calendar days after payoff) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 7 | 15 | none | 30 |

**Notes**

- *Prepayment penalty.* No program charges a penalty for paying the loan off early or for paying extra principal early.
- *Lien release.* The figure is the number of calendar days after payoff within which the lien on the home's title is released.
- *Good-through period.* The figure is a count of calendar days after the statement date.

*Hypothetical date reading:* 15 calendar days after a statement dated 2026-03-02 is 2026-03-17.
